result:
I've completed the US/DE intercompany reconciliation. Here's what I found and did:

## The difference (USD 10,450 vs EUR 7,800) broke into three parts:

**1. Booked — ICI-DE-02, EUR 500** (JE-00309, DE, 3/31)
US billed DE for CI/CD tooling seats in March (JE-00272) but DE never recorded its side. I posted `Dr 6200 Software Subscriptions / Cr 2300 Intercompany Payable` for EUR 500, supported by DOC-0190. The invoice is EUR-denominated, so DE records it with no FX element. I used account 6200 to mirror DE's treatment of the prior software recharge ICI-DE-01. At USD 550 equivalent it's well under the USD 10,000 threshold, so no approval request was needed.

**2. No entry required — USD 156 FX remeasurement**
This is a *correct* difference, not an out-of-balance. The US receivable is EUR-denominated and remeasured to the 3/31 policy rate of 1.10 (EUR 7,800 @1.08 = 8,424 → @1.10 = 8,580). DE carries the same EUR 7,800 in its functional currency. In EUR the two sides agree, so no DE entry arises.

**3. Escalated — USD 1,320 (EXC-001)**
JE-00306 "IC adj DE per call" has **no supporting document** and I could find no corresponding intercompany invoice anywhere in the document store — only ICI-DE-01 and ICI-DE-02 exist. There's also no cash settlement to explain it.

I deliberately did **not** book EUR 1,200 on DE's side. Doing so would have made the ledgers agree, but with no evidence DE received anything it would be exactly the forced reconciliation the policy manual prohibits (DOC-0005 s.11). Instead it's flagged for controller review with two clean resolution paths: produce support, or reverse JE-00306 — the latter brings US 1400 to USD 9,130 and reconciles in full.

## Result
DE's payable is now EUR 8,300, fully supported and agreeing to every US charge backed by an invoice. I marked **DE intercompany reconciliation complete** and **US blocked** pending disposition of JE-00306.

One thing worth your attention: the unsupported USD 1,320 also credited 4800 Intercompany Management Fee Income, so US Q1 intercompany income may be overstated by that amount if the charge can't be substantiated. Given the entry was posted manually by the controller himself on 3/30, it may be worth a direct conversation rather than just the exception queue.
